FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 7.
NOTES- Perhaps 1 out of Fifty
Page 1 OCT. 7 Festa SSi Rosarii. Mrs. Mary Schwab - 60 - coming here nearly two yrs with lump in breast; beginning to bother quite a little of late. Having lost a sister and her mother with cancer she fears an opera- tion - has avoided doctors. Proposes to read "City of God" ..... is advised
Oct. 7 Adolph Franklin - 62 - Baptist - (black) - Cateracts, one removed can see now dimly
7th John Payne - 31 - presbiterien - almost blind .... took treatment could not stand pressure. fears other attempt at operation. Is en- rolled in S.M.Assn. 5.00 to-day
8th Gladys Newberry - 33 - Mother of four threatened with goitre opera- tion - had heart trouble too. .. - promises to enroll the Poor Souls - bargains with them - if she escapes operation, the expences go to them - for missions, etc. She has been - rather was sick and sickly for 6 yrs. To-day comes healthy and joyful starts promise .... with $ 10.00
John Naumeyer - 76 - hopeless cancer - had six operations - after enrolling in perfect health to-day. Deo Gr.
Florence Heig - Operation for Cancer in rectum avoided - promised P.P. souls
Daniel L. Boyer - 53 - "nothing" - mason however ... has not spoken to his son for ten yrs. Wife Catholic asks for prayers ....
Wm. Carpenter & wife .... looking for house or rooms .... rooms .... 9384 Goethe Ave.
Baby Robert James McElgunn - 6 month - pneu.
Page 1A 19 Mrs. Emma Candle - 76 - operated on for stomach - cancer last Mon- day - reported is failing rapidly. ... Proposed to read City
